sql: SELECT Currency, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customers GROUP BY Currency
SELECT DISTINCT city FROM zip_code WHERE county = 'Orange County' AND state = 'Virginia'
SELECT SUM(cost) FROM expense WHERE expense_description = 'Pizza'

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, m.position, m.link_to_major, ma.major_name, ma.department
FROM member m
JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
WHERE m.position = 'President';
SELECT t.Time FROM transactions_1k t JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID WHERE g.ChainID = 11

SELECT e.event_name, e.status, b.spent, b.amount, (b.spent * 1.0 / b.amount) AS ratio
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE e.status = 'Closed'
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.CustomerID FROM customers c INNER JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' GROUP BY c.CustomerID HAVING SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) > 1000)

SELECT e.status FROM event e JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event JOIN expense ex ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id WHERE ex.expense_description = 'Post Cards, Posters' AND ex.expense_date = '2019-8-20'
SELECT MAX(spent) FROM budget

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, e.event_name FROM member m JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN event e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event WHERE m.first_name = 'Maya' AND m.last_name = 'Mclean' AND e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'
SELECT DISTINCT p.Description FROM products p INNER JOIN transactions_1k t ON p.ProductID = t.ProductID INNER JOIN yearmonth ym ON t.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID WHERE ym.Date = '201309'

SELECT ym.CustomerID, ym.Date, ym.Consumption
FROM yearmonth ym
WHERE ym.Date = '201208'
AND ym.CustomerID IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k t
    WHERE t.ProductID = 5
    AND t.Price * 1.0 / t.Amount > 29.00
)

SELECT e.event_name, ex.expense_description, ex.cost
FROM expense ex
JOIN budget b ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'September Speaker' AND ex.expense_description = 'Posters'
SELECT e.event_name, b.spent FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.category = 'Advertisement' ORDER BY b.spent DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT DISTINCT b.category FROM event e JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.location = 'MU 215' AND e.type = 'Guest Speaker' AND b.spent = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 1
  AND strftime('%Y', e."Examination Date") = '1997'
  AND p.SEX = 'F'

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN ex.cost ELSE 0 END) / SUM(ex.cost)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM expense ex
LEFT JOIN budget b ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
LEFT JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id;

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis, e.`Examination Date`, e.`aCL IgM` FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND p.Description = '1994-02-19' AND e.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12'
SELECT e.event_name, b.spent FROM event e JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event ORDER BY b.spent ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX = 'M' AND l.WBC > 3.5 AND l.WBC < 9.0 AND (l.FG <= 150 OR l.FG >= 450)
SELECT p.Diagnosis AS Disease, l.Date AS LabDate FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.ID = 30609 ORDER BY l.Date
SELECT ROUND(AVG(2025 - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)), 2) AS avg_age FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX = 'M' AND l.`T-CHO` >= 250

SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN l.ID END) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) * 100, 2) AS percentage_female_abnormal_pt FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday)) > 55 AND l.PT >= 14
SELECT Diagnosis, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM Laboratory L JOIN Examination E ON L.ID = E.ID WHERE L.IGM <= 40 OR L.IGM >= 400 GROUP BY Diagnosis ORDER BY cnt DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX = 'M' AND l.CENTROMEA IN ('-', '+-') AND l.SSB IN ('-', '+-')
SELECT AVG(PA.overall_rating) FROM Player P JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.player_name = 'Pietro Marino'

SELECT AVG(t2.overall_rating) as avg_rating
FROM Player t1
JOIN Player_Attributes t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id
WHERE t1.height > 170
  AND strftime('%Y', t2.date) >= '2010'
  AND strftime('%Y', t2.date) <= '2015'
SELECT pa.overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Mooy' AND pa.date LIKE '2016-02-04%'

SELECT p.player_name, pa.date, pa.attacking_work_rate FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore' AND pa.date LIKE '2015-05-01%'

SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pa.preferred_foot = 'left' THEN p.player_fifa_api_id END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_fifa_api_id), 2) AS percentage
FROM Player p
LEFT JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_fifa_api_id = pa.player_fifa_api_id
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', p.birthday) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1987 AND 1992

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name, p.birthday, 
       CAST((JULIANDAY('now') - JULIANDAY(p.birthday)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.sprint_speed >= 97
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', pa.date) AS INTEGER) >= 2013
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', pa.date) AS INTEGER) <= 2015
SELECT p.player_name, pa.overall_rating FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id ORDER BY pa.overall_rating DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.player_name, AVG(pa.ball_control) as avg_ball_control FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' OR p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' GROUP BY p.player_name

SELECT AVG(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic') AND SUBSTR(date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21'
SELECT p.player_name, pa.overall_rating FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id ORDER BY pa.overall_rating DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT r.name FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE c.country = 'Germany'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results WHERE raceId = 38 AND time IS NULL

SELECT d.surname, MIN(q.q2) as best_q2
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE q.raceId = 19 AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL AND q.q2 != ''
GROUP BY q.driverId
ORDER BY best_q2 ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT c.lat, c.lng FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.name = 'Abu Dhabi Grand Prix' LIMIT 1

SELECT d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.dob
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE r.raceId = 592 AND r.time IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d.dob ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.url FROM lapTimes lt JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId WHERE lt.raceId = 161 AND lt.time LIKE '1:27%' GROUP BY lt.driverId
SELECT name FROM races WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1950' AND strftime('%m', date) = '05'

SELECT d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality, MAX(CAST(r.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) AS max_speed
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE r.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL AND r.fastestLapSpeed != ''
GROUP BY d.driverId
ORDER BY max_speed DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, SUM(r.points) as total_points FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId GROUP BY d.driverId ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(milliseconds) FROM lapTimes WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix' AND year = 2009) AND driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Lewis' AND surname = 'Hamilton')
SELECT circuitRef FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality, SUM(ds.wins) AS total_wins, MAX(ds.points) AS max_points
FROM driverStandings ds
JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId
GROUP BY ds.driverId
ORDER BY total_wins DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.name, MAX(cr.points) AS max_points FROM constructors c JOIN constructorResults cr ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId WHERE c.nationality = 'British' GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name ORDER BY max_points DESC;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.dob, r.year, r.name, r.date, r.time FROM drivers d JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverId = q.driverId JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId WHERE d.driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM drivers ORDER BY dob DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY r.date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE gender_id = 2
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE c.colour = 'Gold' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
SELECT c.colour FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan'

SELECT c.name, c.nationality, SUM(cr.points) as total_points
FROM constructorResults cr
JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
WHERE cr.raceId IN (
  SELECT r.raceId FROM races r WHERE r.name LIKE '%Monaco%' AND r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
)
GROUP BY cr.constructorId
ORDER BY total_points DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE u.Age > 65 AND p.Score >= 20
SELECT Text FROM comments WHERE Score = 17

SELECT g.gender
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Phoenix Force';
SELECT u.DisplayName FROM votes v JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id WHERE v.Id = 6347;
SELECT c.Id, c.PostId, c.UserId, c.CreationDate, p.ClosedDate FROM comments c JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id WHERE c.UserId = '23853' AND c.CreationDate = '2013-07-12 09:08:18.0'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.Id) FROM users u INNER JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId WHERE u.Location = 'United Kingdom' AND p.FavoriteCount >= 4
SELECT p.Id, p.Title, p.ViewCount FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky' ORDER BY p.ViewCount DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2010' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2011' THEN 1 END) AS ratio FROM votes

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE (weight_kg = 0 OR weight_kg IS NULL) AND eye_colour_id = 7) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE (weight_kg = 0 OR weight_kg IS NULL) AND eye_colour_id = 1) AS difference;

SELECT p.Title, AVG(p.ViewCount) AS AvgViewCount, c.Text AS Comment
FROM posts p
JOIN comments c ON p.Id = c.PostId
WHERE p.Tags LIKE '%<humor>%'
GROUP BY p.Id, c.Text
ORDER BY p.Id, c.Id

SELECT c.Text, c.CreationDate, COALESCE(u.DisplayName, c.UserDisplayName) AS DisplayName FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id WHERE c.PostId = 7146 ORDER BY c.CreationDate DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN borderColor = 'borderless' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(id) * 100, 2) AS percentage FROM cards
SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN u.UpVotes = 0 THEN 1 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM comments c JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id WHERE c.Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10
SELECT DISTINCT l.status FROM cards c JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid WHERE c.types LIKE '%Artifact%' AND c.side IS NULL AND l.format = 'vintage'
SELECT language FROM foreign_data WHERE multiverseid = 149934
SELECT translation FROM set_translations WHERE setCode = (SELECT code FROM sets WHERE name = 'Eighth Edition') AND language = 'Chinese Simplified'
SELECT flavorText FROM foreign_data WHERE uuid = (SELECT uuid FROM cards WHERE name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' LIMIT 1) AND language = 'Italian'

SELECT c.name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT l.format ORDER BY l.format) AS legal_formats FROM cards c JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid WHERE c.setCode = (SELECT code FROM sets WHERE name = 'Hour of Devastation') AND l.status = 'Legal' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY c.name

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN a.atom_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id), 2) AS carbon_percentage FROM atom a JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = '='
SELECT b.bond_type FROM connected c JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE (c.atom_id = 'TR004_8' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR004_20')
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004' ORDER BY element
SELECT AVG(bond_count) FROM (SELECT a.atom_id, COUNT(c.bond_id) AS bond_count FROM atom a LEFT JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id WHERE a.element = 'i' GROUP BY a.atom_id)
SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY cnt DESC

SELECT ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOWER(a.element) != 'f' THEN a.molecule_id END) * 100.0) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id), 2) AS percentage FROM molecule m LEFT JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+'

SELECT a1.element AS element_1, a2.element AS element_2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11'

SELECT DISTINCT a1.element AS element1, a2.element AS element2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) as count FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND substr(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4' GROUP BY a.element ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) || '%' AS ratio, (SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006') AS label FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip, f.`Enrollment (K-12)`, f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`, (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS diff FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 30 ORDER BY diff DESC

SELECT s.sname AS school_name, s.AvgScrWrite AS avg_writing_score, sch.CharterNum AS charter_number
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND sch.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT s.School, s.Phone, sc.AvgScrWrite
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE (s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01')
ORDER BY s.School
SELECT s.School, f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS Enrollment_Grades_1_12 FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.DOC = '31' ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC;
SELECT s.Phone FROM satscores sc JOIN schools s ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE sc.dname = 'Fresno Unified' AND sc.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sc.AvgScrRead ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS school_count FROM schools WHERE County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara') AND Virtual = 'F' GROUP BY County;

SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS account_open_date, l.loan_id, l.amount AS approved_amount, l.duration, l.date AS loan_date
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_date, d.A2 AS district_name
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client WHERE gender = 'M' AND district_id = 74;

SELECT c.client_id, CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age FROM card cd JOIN disp d ON cd.disp_id = d.disp_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE cd.type = 'gold' AND d.type = 'OWNER' ORDER BY c.client_id
SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN f.language = 'French' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage FROM cards c JOIN foreign_data f ON c.uuid = f.uuid WHERE c.power IS NULL OR c.power = '*';

SELECT c.name AS circuit_name, c.location, lt.lap, lt.time, lt.milliseconds, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.name AS race_name
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE c.country = 'Italy'
  AND lt.milliseconds = (
    SELECT MIN(lt2.milliseconds)
    FROM lapTimes lt2
    JOIN races r2 ON lt2.raceId = r2.raceId
    WHERE r2.circuitId = c.circuitId
  )
ORDER BY c.circuitId;
